title: Weighted study-level meta-regression
assumptions: Covariates were prespecified and are complete
One independent effect contributes per analysis unit
The units-per-covariate feasibility threshold is met
limitations: Uses a weighted linear model without REML residual heterogeneity estimation
Does not implement robust variance estimation
Study-level associations are not individual-level causal effects
do_not_use_when: Covariates were selected after inspecting results
There are too few independent units per covariate
Effects share participants without an approved dependence model
